faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at AIIMS Delhi is 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree in any discipline. A background in Life Sciences and proficiency in MS Office are considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 50 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed criteria.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Scientific Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line clearly states the post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Delhi apply for this post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any geographical restrictions for applicants. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such details.
